issue.title: bead_task_triage never reconciles gates for a project key that left the enabled inventory, leaving 11 live zombie TaskTriage notifications
issue.description:
ROOT CAUSE: _reconcile() in src/sase/scripts/sase_chop_bead_task_triage.py only iterates projects returned by _enabled_project_stores() (line 473). Its lane state, however, is keyed by project and is read/written wholesale (_read_state/_write_state). A project key that leaves the enabled inventory — renamed, deregistered, or disabled — keeps its gates/generations/fingerprints/kinds entries forever, and its pending gate bundles are never inspected, never cancelled, and their notifications never settle. The chop cannot cancel them because it never visits that project again.

EVIDENCE (this host, 2026-08-10): ~/.sase/axe/lumberjacks/checks/bead_task_triage.json still holds a project entry 'gh_sase-org__sase-2', which is not in ~/.sase/projects/ and not in 'sase project list' (only actstat, bob-cli, and sase are registered). Of the 12 currently pending task_triage gate bundles in ~/.sase/interaction_requests/task_triage, 11 belong to that dead key and have been pending since 2026-08-02: sase-cl, sase-ct, sase-cu, sase-dn, sase-dy, sase-e5, sase-ec, sase-ed, sase-ee, sase-ef (all created 08-02 14:40) and sase-cb (08-02 15:15). Each request.json records producer {"chop": "bead_task_triage", "project": "gh_sase-org__sase-2"} and names a live notification id, e.g. bead-task-triage-sase-cl-1c7fbbb5b5e5-g1 -> 49d096cf-ca8b-4675-9ae7-adcd7bfefcef. Only one pending gate (sase-cj under gh_sase-org__sase) is legitimate. The beads themselves are duplicated across both keys in the state file, so the same bead was gated twice under two keys.

IMPACT: violates the chop's own documented invariant that a live task bead has at most one pending gate (docs/axe.md, docs/notifications.md). The user gets task-triage notifications that can never be cleared by the owning chop and that reference a project that no longer exists. The state file also grows without bound: it currently carries a stale gh_bobs-org__bob-cli entry and ~180 sase entries.

SCOPE: teach the reconciler to handle project keys present in lane state but absent from the current enabled inventory — cancel their pending gates with a distinct reason and drop their state entries — while failing closed when the inventory read itself fails (_enabled_project_stores already returns early on error, and a partial inventory must not be treated as 'these projects are gone'). Decide and document what a temporarily *disabled* project should do (cancel vs retain). Include a one-time cleanup of the 11 gates and notifications listed above. Add regression tests alongside tests/test_axe_chop_bead_task_triage.py.

CONTEXT: found while diagnosing a separate, confirmed defect in the same chop — it re-raises a gate for a task bead whose launch is still in flight — which is covered by its own tale plan proposed 2026-08-10. Do not conflate the two: different trigger, different fix.

payload.close_reason: Let's punt on this for now.
